Vincent & Julien,

I’m available any evening except Mondays or Wednesdays (French classes on those days).  
Thursdays are best, then Tuesdays.

This week, I’ll be off Thursday afternoon to visit family in Provence, so Friday is also out.  
Fridays are usually fine though, but I’d need to bring my partner along.

Bottom line: How about next Thursday 11/15?

Also, the earlier the better (office hours 7am-5pm).

Looking forward to it.

— Marc
